name: analyze_audio
description: Analyze audio content using Gemini. Can transcribe, describe sounds, identify music, etc. Waits for the analysis and returns it.

file_path.description: Path to the audio file to analyze

prompt.description: What to analyze (e.g. 'Transcribe this audio', 'What sounds are in this?')

returns: The analysis text. If it runs longer than about 90 seconds, a task_id to check with get_task_status instead.
notes: Usually returns the analysis directly; only a very long recording comes back as a task_id for get_task_status.
